dataRoles.sensorConfidence: ARKitScenes raw confidence aligned with the frozen orientation-witness procedure
dataRoles.cameraPose: CA-1M FARO-registered released frame pose after explicit coordinate-convention validation
dataRoles.referenceGeometry: CA-1M FARO rendered depth back-projected with released FARO intrinsics and registered poses
dataRoles.orientationWitnessOnly: ARKitScenes raw lowres_depth; never a reconstruction target

methods.weight: frozen inverse variance with sensorConfidencePenalty forced to 0; all other U1b coefficients unchanged
methods.role: ablation for depth dependence without confidence

methods.weight: frozen U1b inverse variance after deterministic within-scene confidence permutation

frameSelection.policy: deterministic temporal quantiles over complete CA-1M frames after structural validity checks, without using FARO error or confidence values
frameSelection.formula: for K views among N complete frames, select the nearest integer index to i*(N-1)/(K-1) for i=0..K-1; exact half-index ties choose the lower original frame index

poseConventionPreflight.releasedInterpretation: gt/RT is camera-to-world in FARO laser-scanner coordinates
poseConventionPreflight.validation: cross-project FARO depth between deterministic adjacent-frame pairs under both released camera-to-world and inverse interpretations
poseConventionPreflight.passRule: released interpretation must have lower scene median cross-projection depth disagreement and win a majority of comparable adjacent-frame pairs in every evaluation scene

volume.bounds: one shared robust automatic bound per scene/view selection, reused unchanged across methods
volume.reason: same projection/truncation/meshing for every method; only sample weights may differ

referenceSampling.source: FARO GT depth from all structurally valid frames in the frozen scene
referenceSampling.downsampling: stable SHA-256 rank over scene/frame/pixel identity

stressTests.depthDropout: deterministic per-sample SHA-256 mask with seed 42, identical mask across methods
stressTests.perturbation: deterministic scene/frame directions from seed 42, identical across methods
stressTests.executionOrder: primary 8-view clean comparison first; stress grids only after primary outputs are frozen

fairnessConstraints: No method may change frame selection, reference points, volume bounds, voxel size, truncation distance, or mesh extraction.
No method may remove samples based on FARO residuals.
The frozen U1b coefficients may not be retuned on U3 scenes.
The shuffled control preserves each scene's exact confidence distribution.
If CA-1M pose semantics fail coordinate-convention validation, U3 stops for an adapter correction before any geometry comparison is interpreted.
claimPolicy: U2 establishes uncertainty prediction, not reconstruction improvement. U3 may claim geometry improvement only if the preregistered primary gate passes; otherwise report the null/negative geometry result without altering U1b.
